QuestInfo.name: The Taste of Luxury
QuestInfo.0: #p2111008# started acting really weird when he saw the Order Request.
QuestInfo.1: #p2111008# managed to break the most important part of your convertible, the Lidium Engine, and he doesn't make nearly enough money to pay for it.
QuestInfo.2: You gave 10 million Mesos to #p2111008# and got yourself a sweet convertible. Kind of costly, but it looks so AWESOME!

0.0: Okay, so it's going to be a little longer on that convertible. It's really technical stuff, you wouldn't understand...
0.1: Look, I'm sorry! I was trying to get that Lidium Engine put together, b-but then it just fell out of the mounts and...
0.2: You gotta understand, I could reconstruct the engine, but Lidium costs an arm and a leg! I just can't replace it...
0.3: I tried to buy refined Lidium with the paychecks I saved up, but the price went up and I just can't buy it... I'm s-sorry, but... If it's possible... you could give me a bit more...

yes.0: You are so generous, you really are! I just need about 10 million Mesos to get the Lidium back! I've got a broker ready and everything! I'll have it when you get back!

no.0: Please, I'm super duper sorry! If Sir Carson finds out, he's going to sell me like a donkey!

default.0: Y-you didn't get the money?! But I already ordered the Lidium! What do I do?!! They're going to turn me into a lab rat!
